Outside, a covered pergola with stone pavers creates a perfect setting for outdoor dining & relaxation. The paver patio continues towards a grassy backyard and garden space. The beach is about 4 miles to the west. There is plenty of everything around in the way of shopping, food, and fun. We've both lived in southern California for a long time so feel free to ask any questions if you're new to the area.

title: Bedroom Available - Giant Redondo House!
description:
QR Code Link to This Post
Private bedroom available for July 1st in a gigantic 4BR house. The room is reasonably large at approximately 150 sqft with full sliding door closet, and shares a bathroom with one other room. Price is $1275 plus utilities (utilities are ~$80/person).
Fantastic location, lots of parking, and gorgeous back yard ... and as the master tenant I expect to keep making upgrades to make this house a wonderful place for people to live in and build community in.
I’m a 44-year old wind energy professional that loves music, karaoke and trivia. I have a scuba divemaster certification and a history of traveling the world, including living in both Denmark and Colombia. I try to regularly go bicycling and climbing and want to get out more to explore the LA area (I moved to the area last summer from Denmark via a stop back home near San Francisco).
The other housemates are Austin, a 26 year-old video producer from Michigan who used to play hockey and also climbs; and Sevag, a 39 year-old guitarist and chef from Syria who's spent chunks of time playing music in Nashville and cooks amazing Mediterranean food. Sevag also has a friendly housecat.
I'm looking for people that are first of all reliable and responsible and low drama. Beyond that, I'm trying to build a shared community here in which people make use of the house for dinners, BBQs, game nights and other creative gatherings, and I am looking for housemates that want to be part of that vision, taking the initiative to plan gatherings and enjoying being hosts. I also plan to get a dog in the coming months, and want people who would welcome a pet in the house (potentially even people who already have their own pet that would play nice with an additional dog).
Initial lease terms are flexible, but I would start with no more than 6 months with the hope of extending afterward to a year+ if it turns out to be a fit.
If you are interested, or want to know more, please reach out!
Cheers,
-Ari

Welcome to my thoughtfully designed, fully-furnished two bedroom/two bathroom apartment in the heart of Pasadena. This is the second time renting this meticulously cared for space, and I'm looking for tenants who will treat it like their own home.

You're located within a short driving distance of downtown Pasadena (8 mins), downtown LA (25 mins), Echo Park/Silverlake (20 mins), and Highland Park (15 mins). We especially love being close to two farmer's markets: South Pasadena on Thursdays and the Pasadena one on Saturdays and a 10 minute drive to the Huntington Library.
The neighborhood itself is a walker's paradise - quiet, super lush, on family-friendly streets with a park (McDonald Park) just around the block.
Other amenities include:
- Huge closets in each bedroom
- A desk and workspace in one bedroom
- Whole-home integrated speaker system
- Oversized outdoor deck as well as separate firepit
- Ample street parking, driveway parking is available for a $100 monthly fee
- A subway station that's only a 15minute walk away if you prefer public transport

**Available for Rent between June 20 - August 15th, 2025** Weekly rental rate $700/wk, 4-wk rental minimum.

We are foodies, so the kitchen is stocked with all the tools you need to make a great meal, including a dishwasher and toaster oven (however please note there is no microwave). The house was built in 2023 so everything is brand new!
Coming in at around 1200 sq ft, it feels luxurious for 2 people living in Los Angeles. You'll have lots of space! It is fully furnished with a Queen bed, a walk in closet and a wall-mounted TV that has all the streaming channels.
This house is located in El Sereno, South Of Huntington Drive, in a very old, quiet neighborhood in East LA lined with Palm trees. We are 10 minutes away from USC Keck Medical Center and Cal State LA, and 15 minutes away from Highland Park! We are just a few minutes drive from fanatistic local hiking spots Ascot Hills and Ernst E. Debs Park, and there are multiple taco stands and local eateries within a 2 mile radius. There are 7 grocery stores within a 10 minute drive, including a Costco.
The house also comes with:
-parking (1 spot)
-central heat/air
-a back patio (where we have a grill)
-laundry
-walking distance to bodega
-utilities and wifi included in rental rate
Please note that there are 3 stairs at the front door and that the hallway is not wide enough for a wheelchair.
If you are unable to do a full month's rental, we will consider weekly rentals as well, based on the monthly rental rate.
We are two filmmakers who are looking for someone, or a couple, that is clean and quiet to enjoy our home while we're gone.
Rental requirements
If you are interested please tell me a little bit about yourself! Where you're from, why you will be in LA, what you do, etc etc. We will do a zoom interview with you before renting, a credit check, a criminal background check on everyone who will be residing in the house, and ask for references. This is because we have other tenants on the property (in a separate house) who's safety we need to ensure. Refundable security deposit of $750 required upon signing contract.
Pets Policy
Pets will be allowed on a case by case basis. We have one cat (as pictured) but she will be traveling with us.

This beauty is from Tiny Homes ATX based out of Texas built in 2024. I purchased it and had it delivered this past December to it's current home in Monrovia, California.
This open space design allows for maximum use of every bit of space which is important in a tiny home.   The original stairs didn't quite work for us so we had a custom staircase built that was more comfortable and functional.  If you want to  enjoy more space while hanging out below in the living room area you can easily lift the steps out of the way and bring them back down when you're ready to use them. A secure ladder option has also been added by the smaller loft for added convenience.
Several other changes have been made to the original layout including 2 additional kitchen cabinets and relocating the area for the refrigerator to behind the wall. The electric induction stove top that came with this unit was replaced with a 4 burner propane gas range due to the current electrical source that is provided by the property not being sufficient to handle the stove requirements. Nor that of the instant hot water heater that originally came with this home. I replaced it as well with a new 30 Gallon gas water heater installed beside the home.
The propane stove and gas water heater are much more energy and cost efficient.
Should you decide that you would like to swap out the propane stove for the electric range it is stored in a box in the shed.
Speaking of.. a newly built 8x10 shed is included providing ample storage space.  It is also where a new washer and electric dryer are located. They aren't currently hooked up as we had decided to sell the home before we ever needed to use them.
The lofts can be used as bedrooms or office space both come with added cube storage shelves with storage boxes that are not yet shown in the photos.  Each loft has a skylight for added natural light and cell shades to darken the space when desired.
A retractable screen door was installed allowing for
fresh air to flow in while keeping the bugs out. There is 1 dedicated off street parking beside the home and additional free street parking.
The added porch awning adds a comfortable place to relax outside without the sun beating down on you on hot days and provides great coverage when it's raining.
Both the kitchen and bathroom have exhaust fans.  The tiled shower has a large shower head and a removable shower wand.

From Rodeo Drive and Beverly Hills to Hollywood and Chinatown, there is the perfect neighborhood for everyone in Los Angeles.
From celebrity sightings to unbeatable shopping destinations, Los Angeles is hard to beat. Enjoy a hike in the Santa Monica Mountains, Griffith Park, or Topanga State Park, enjoy the famous entertainment at Universal Studios Hollywood, see the stars along the legendary Hollywood Walk of Fame, or stop in to the Los Angeles County Museum of Art. Your options are endless for entertainment, dining, and shopping in Los Angeles. And don’t forget about the easy access to international travel through the expansive Los Angeles International Airport.
Though Los Angeles is famous for its film industry, it’s also well-known for its amazing beaches like Venice Beach, Santa Monica Beach, El Matador Beach, Manhattan Beach, and Hermosa Beach. After a day of surfing and swimming, catch a sporting event or a live show at LA Live, housing the Microsoft Theatre, the STAPLES Center, the Grammy Museum, and a variety of restaurants and nightclubs. Outside of entertainment, Los Angeles houses numerous prestigious colleges and universities, from the University of California, Los Angeles to the University of Southern California.

title: Beautiful Tiny Home Trailer with Shed and Deck (Monrovia)
description:
QR Code Link to This Post
This beauty is from Tiny Homes ATX based out of Texas built in 2024. I purchased it and had it delivered this past December to it's current home in Monrovia, California.
This open space design allows for maximum use of every bit of space which is important in a tiny home.   The original stairs didn't quite work for us so we had a custom staircase built that was more comfortable and functional.  If you want to  enjoy more space while hanging out below in the living room area you can easily lift the steps out of the way and bring them back down when you're ready to use them. A secure ladder option has also been added by the smaller loft for added convenience.
Several other changes have been made to the original layout including 2 additional kitchen cabinets and relocating the area for the refrigerator to behind the wall. The electric induction stove top that came with this unit was replaced with a 4 burner propane gas range due to the current electrical source that is provided by the property not being sufficient to handle the stove requirements. Nor that of the instant hot water heater that originally came with this home. I replaced it as well with a new 30 Gallon gas water heater installed beside the home.
The propane stove and gas water heater are much more energy and cost efficient.
Should you decide that you would like to swap out the propane stove for the electric range it is stored in a box in the shed.
Speaking of.. a newly built 8x10 shed is included providing ample storage space.  It is also where a new washer and electric dryer are located. They aren't currently hooked up as we had decided to sell the home before we ever needed to use them.
The lofts can be used as bedrooms or office space both come with added cube storage shelves with storage boxes that are not yet shown in the photos.  Each loft has a skylight for added natural light and cell shades to darken the space when desired.
A retractable screen door was installed allowing for
fresh air to flow in while keeping the bugs out. There is 1 dedicated off street parking beside the home and additional free street parking.
The added porch awning adds a comfortable place to relax outside without the sun beating down on you on hot days and provides great coverage when it's raining.
Both the kitchen and bathroom have exhaust fans.  The tiled shower has a large shower head and a removable shower wand.
Here are the home specs:
MEASUREMENTS

If you are wanting to purchase and live in this tiny home at its current location you would first need to submit a rental application with the property to pre-qualify.  I will have some applications at the open house this weekend or you can request that I send you one. *Bonus - you get one month rent free!
Don’t miss out on a great opportunity to own this bequtiful home at just $125k! At the moment the monthly rent is $925. That may be going up for new move ins as early as next week. I can provide some lending options as well.
This location is a rare find in this San Gabriel Valley area. It is a couple blocks from Arcadia and just a short distance to the popular old town of Monrovia. It is clean and quiet and in a very safe neighborhood. Easy access to the Metro station, bus lines and freeway. And conveniently located to nearby grocery stores and shops as well as schools.

Perched above the historic Monterey Road Pass in the cozy hillside neighborhood of Hermon, this updated and remodeled home offers scenic views and tranquil living. Tucked between Arroyo Seco, Monterey Hills, Highland Park, and South Pasadena, you’ll find a hidden gem that blends peaceful seclusion with easy city access. Brick-lined stairs lead to a charming composite front deck, perfect for morning coffee or evening sunsets with views stretching across Hermon and the Monterey Hills. Entering through the front door, the living room welcomes you with engineered hardwood flooring and dual-pane windows that fill the space with natural light. The layout flows into a dining area and a thoughtfully updated kitchen with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances—including a gas range, dishwasher, microwave, and fridge—and easy-to-clean linoleum flooring. Down the hall, both bedrooms are comfortably sized and feature lighted ceiling fans and generous closets. The first bathroom boasts tile flooring, a dual-sink vanity with river rock countertops, and a custom-tiled shower stall with a rain shower head and matching river rock floors. At the end of the hall is a second full bathroom with sleek black hex tile, a deep soaking tub with oversized subway tile walls, a rain shower head, handheld shower head, and a stylish single-sink vanity. A brand-new stackable washer and dryer is conveniently tucked away here too. Out back, the home extends into a multi-level outdoor oasis. A wood deck off the kitchen makes for a great dining or lounge spot, leading up to a terraced hillside landscaped with lush greenery. The middle terrace offers a patch of artificial grass, market lights, and multiple spots to entertain or relax. Climb a bit higher and you’ll find a quiet seating area at the top—ideal for taking in panoramic views of the hills and skyline. Backed up against Ernest E. Debs Regional Park and with quick access to Rose Hill Park, Hermon Park, Downtown LA, and Dodger Stadium via the Arroyo Seco Parkway, this hillside retreat offers both charm and convenience in one of Northeast LA’s best-kept secrets.

title: Your own little house! 1/1 cottage w/shared patio & room to garden (Long Beach)
description:
QR Code Link to This Post
Roomy and bright 1 bedroom/1 bath cottage with onsite management on a 3-unit lot. The property is in the Poly High neighborhood, close to Signal Hill, Bixby Knolls and minutes from CSULB, DTLB and the beach. It is a short distance to many shops and restaurants, close to Long Beach transit, the LA Metro Blue (A) line train, easy access to the 405 and 710 freeways, and 1 mile from Long Beach Memorial and St Mary's hospitals.  The charming, family-friendly neighborhood gets daily visits from the elotero and ice cream truck and there are fruterias and tamale stands within a few blocks.
The freestanding cottage features brand new kitchen cabinets with quartz countertops, tile floors, new light fixtures and cordless blinds, and fresh paint throughout. The house has lots of windows on every side for a bright home and plenty of fresh air. The electrical has been completely redone and there are so many outlets in every room, you'll wonder what else you can plug in. The living area is bright and roomy with a brand-new ceiling fan and wall heater. Ceiling fan reverses in the winter to circulate warm air and keep you toasty. The bedroom has a brand-new ceiling fan, deep closet and room for creative storage options. The bathroom has all new fixtures and room for more storage. Exterior lighting is dusk to dawn enabled, so you'll never arrive home in the dark. There is a fenced yard with numerous fruit trees, a patio area, and space for gardening. Street parking only for cars, but we may be able to accommodate a motorcycle on the property. You will supply your own refrigerator; a gas stove is included. Indoor-only cats (limit 2) are welcome with approval, other pets will be considered on a case by case basis ($500 refundable pet deposit, pets must be spayed/neutered, current on vaccinations and licensed if required by Long Beach), NO DOGS except service dogs trained to assist a disabled person.
Note about in-unit laundry: unit does not have standard W/D connections, but there is space in the bathroom for a compact washer and electric dryer, like those advertised for apartments, RV, or portable. We will work with the tenant for proper setup of these appliances that you provide. Dryer must be electric, there is no gas hookup.
OPEN HOUSE EVERY TUESDAY/THURSDAY 4-7PM AND SATURDAY 10-2.
